verdict.rationale: Neon has a dedicated first-party Autoscaling doc page and a Scale to Zero page, and it positions itself as a 'serverless database that scales' with storage and compute separated. That supports compute adjusting automatically to load and down to zero when idle. The pack contains only page titles and taglines, though, so the actual mechanics are not shown. Missing for 10: details on automatic scale-up and scale-down behavior and limits, explicit evidence of no downtime or connection drops during resizes, and independent or hands-on corroboration of autoscaling under load.
